critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct: INSERT into ClinicBatchClaims (PK=BatchRunId) is the lock, eliminating the concurrency-token contention on ClinicBatchRuns that caused DbUpdateConcurrencyException at file #1.

rca of the issue: Original bug: ClinicBatchRuns row had [Timestamp] RowVersion + LeaseUntil. Runner (CamBatchService.RunAsync) attached the batch row in its own DbContext and saved counters after every processed PDF, while CamBatchQueueWorker.KeepAliveAsync renewed LeaseUntil on the same row from a different DbContext. First heartbeat between file #1's start and the runner's first SaveChanges bumped RowVersion, so the runner's save threw DbUpdateConcurrencyException on the very first file. Fix: introduced ClinicBatchClaims (PK=BatchRunId, OwnerInstance, LeaseUntil, ClaimedAt) — the row INSERT is the lock; ClinicBatchRun carries no concurrency token anymore, so the runner and the heartbeat can no longer collide. Renew/Release/FailAbandoned operate exclusively on ClinicBatchClaims. Verified by probe_azure checks 6c-6i and by static grep across the codebase.
